articles.title: China-Linked Hackers Exploit Critical VMware vCenter Zero-Day to Gain Admin Access and Steal Data
articles.executive_summary: China-Linked Hackers Exploit Critical VMware vCenter Zero-Day to Gain Admin Access and Steal Data. The suspected China-nexus cyber espionage group known as Armory Castle (formerly UNC5221) has been attributed to the zero-day exploitation of a critical security flaw in VMware vCenter Server in early September 2026.

actionable_mitigations: Review firewall and perimeter access logs for anomalous traffic patterns.
Verify all endpoint detection (EDR) agents are updated with latest behavioral signatures.
Audit exposed external assets and apply vendor security patches immediately.
